test-release-package-dist: pin trace-reader TODOs 269 to 273 (#286)

Case 27 of tools/test-release-package-dist.py now holds the 5 gaps
that TODOs 269 to 273 record for the trace reader, each with a case
that fails without it. Its docstrings state a rule for what the
reader refuses, with examples, and point to the reader functions as
the code that makes its refusals. The packager and the reader are
unchanged.

- fork() = 101 is read as the call, and its child starts in the
  folder of its maker. A child of fork() = 101 or vfork() = 101 keeps
  that folder when its maker enters another by chdir after the call.
- For each of clone, clone3, fork and vfork, in each of the 9 forms
  in which strace cuts a call short and when it ends with the result
  ? and the note <unavailable>, 1 later process with no maker is
  read by its absolute paths, and a second ends the case, as does a
  relative path in that process. After 2 such calls of the same name
  in the same form, and after a fork and a vfork that each ended with
  the result ?, 2 such processes are read and a third ends the case.
- An unlink read with its arguments that ends as "= ? <unavailable>"
  counts as a removal, in its line and in its resumption. After a
  chdir that ends that way in a shared folder, an absolute path is
  read and a relative path ends the case with the error that names
  it. That strace writes this form for a call whose arguments it
  read is not verified, and the comment and the module docstring say
  so.
- fchdir into a descriptor with no path, or with a relative path,
  ends the case.
- renameat2 gives both of its paths, each read against its own
  descriptor, in a case where the 2 descriptors and the folder of
  the process name 3 different folders.
- New subtests hold refusals that no case on main held, among them
  those of a trace with no call, a resumption with no call open or
  under another name, a path not in hex escapes, a line with no
  process id, and an unread call cut short while a call is open.
- Each subtest whose trace resumes a call with the result ? says
  "resumed with ?" in its label.

Checks: python3 -I tools/test-release-package-dist.py TraceReaderTests
is expected to give 4 tests, OK, here and 3 tests, OK, on main. Each
of the 36 reader mutants that the pull request description lists is
expected to pass case 27 on main and to fail it here. In a git
checkout with strace, the full run is expected to leave cases 1 to
26 as they are on main.
